label: M4P exploration probe: post-hoc, exploratory, no learning; never merged into M4/M4U/M4X tables
repetition_types: 37 cells x 100 episodes on the same 100 training conditions (paired); no training or search seeds; no episode-level confidence intervals

artifacts.artifact: M4P tack grid and per-cell results
commands: env -u PYTHONPATH uv run --frozen --no-sync python experiments/ese3990/probe.py freeze
env -u PYTHONPATH RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run --frozen --no-sync python experiments/ese3990/probe.py run --out runs/ese3990/M4P --jobs 12
env -u PYTHONPATH uv run --frozen --no-sync python experiments/ese3990/probe.py report --run runs/ese3990/M4P --out docs/ese3990 --jobs 12
artifacts.supported_claim: Per-decision white rate noise (the learners' exploration) never tacks on U (0/300 episodes over sigma 0.3/0.6/1.0) and never gains upwind ground; 11 of 37 cells reach the declared threshold, with 11-25% tacks and <= 7% failures: pink at sigma 0.3 at every hold, red at sigma 0.3 with holds >= 0.5 s and at sigma 0.6 with holds <= 0.5 s, and white at sigma 0.3 with 1-2 s holds. No cell makes upwind progress (mean max y <= 5.6 m; <= 2% of episodes reach y = 20 m) and no episode finishes (0/3,700). Declared reading: per-decision white noise is a cause.
